description: This file defines a base class for strategies that determine when a user has started speaking within a conversational or speech processing system. It includes data structures for parameters passed on user turn start, and provides methods for event handling such as pushing and broadcasting frames, as well as setting up and resetting the strategy.

classes.name: UserTurnStartedParams
classes.description: Parameters emitted when a user turn starts. These are passed to event handlers to provide context about user turn handling.

classes.name: BaseUserTurnStartStrategy
classes.description: A base class providing the framework for detecting when a user starts speaking, with event handling and lifecycle management methods.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, enable_interruptions: bool = True, enable_user_speaking_frames: bool = True, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Initializes the strategy with optional interruption and speaking frame enable flags.

methods.name: BaseTaskManager task_manager(self)
methods.description: Property that returns the configured task manager, raising an error if not set.

methods.name: setup(self, task_manager: BaseTaskManager)
methods.description: Associates a task manager with this strategy.

methods.name: cleanup(self)
methods.description: Performs cleanup operations; meant to be overridden.

methods.name: reset(self)
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the strategy; meant to be overridden.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame)
methods.description: Processes an incoming frame; subclasses should override to implement detection logic.

methods.name: push_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection = FrameDirection.DOWNSTREAM)
methods.description: Emits an event to push a frame downstream.

methods.name: broadcast_frame(self, frame_cls: Type[Frame], **kwargs)
methods.description: Emits an event to broadcast a frame class with given attributes.

methods.name: trigger_user_turn_started(self)
methods.description: Triggers the event signaling that a user turn has started, passing relevant parameters.
